body: I corrected the earlier gap with a local watched bout and added a separate entry to research/C17_FIGHT_SCENE.md. Verified: Watch vs Quick Sim; portrait/text broadcast, round clock, rolling commentary, momentum rail, step/play-pause, Normal/Fast speed and Sim to End; no mid-bout decisions. Sampled Thomas Lawrence vs Tommy Meyer ended Meyer arm-triangle submission R1 2:18, with aggregate/round stats, A/All-Timer grade and post-fight interview. This supports a text/event fallback and explicit controls but not FightCamp's 2.5D/3D watchability target; adapter-first recommendation unchanged.
